_comment: Road geometry for every ordered pair (i, j), i != j, of the 22 Chennai nodes; node 0 is the Perungudi depot and node i is collection point i (the same indexing as the travel-time matrix C in solver_core.json). Keys are "i-j". Each value has the leg's encoded polyline (Google polyline format, precision 5, OSRM overview=simplified), its road distance in km and OSRM's free-flow duration in minutes; null means OSRM failed for that pair and the UI should draw a straight line and say so. Use these to DRAW routes only: route durations and costs come from C (which is ×1.5 in the peak scenario). A route drawn by stitching pairwise legs can differ slightly from OSRM's own multi-waypoint route for the same stops, since each leg is optimised independently (e.g. where to approach or leave a stop). Exported by src/export_geometry.py.

nodes.name: Perungudi MSW disposal site, Greater Chennai Corporation
